opportunities.title: Custom Pool Cue Design Website
opportunities.description: I need a complete ecommerce site where visitors can design their own pool cues, see the results in real time, and purchase instantly. Key features • Interactive 3-D configurator – the cue must render live and be fully rotatable so shoppers can inspect every angle before checkout. • Deep custom options – colours, patterns, wrap style, cue length, weight, tip type, plus space for names, text or even user-uploaded graphics. All selections should update the 3-D model on the fly. • Seamless checkout – once finished, customers pay online with any mainstream card or digital wallet. Deliverables 1. Responsive website (preferably on a well-supported platform such as WooCommerce, Shopify or a custom React/Laravel stack) with the 3-D configurator integrated. 2. Admin dashboard to add or edit cue components, pricing rules and promotional codes. 3. Payment gateway setup (Stripe, PayPal or similar) with order confirmation emails and secure SSL. 4. Exportable production file or database entry containing every chosen spec so manufacturing can begin immediately. 5. Brief hand-over session plus basic documentation so I can maintain catalogue items myself. I’m open to your suggested toolset as long as the configurator is smooth on desktop and mobile, load times stay minimal, and the checkout remains friction-less. If you have examples of previous product builders or 3-D e-commerce work, please include them with your proposal.

The concept focuses on simplicity, elegance, functionality, and a perfect balance of aesthetics and comfort. The kitchen features a contemporary modular layout, premium cabinetry, elegant colour combinations, modern appliances, stylish lighting, and smart storage solutions. Every element is carefully designed to create a clean, organized, and luxurious atmosphere. The design combines modern materials, attractive textures, and realistic lighting to achieve a sophisticated interior that is both visually appealing and practical for everyday use. opportunities.title: CNC Upholstered Furniture Frame Engineer
opportunities.description: # Upholstered Furniture Design Engineer & CNC Specialist – Long-Term Cooperation We are **MonoSpace**, an upholstered furniture manufacturing company based in Astana, Kazakhstan. We are looking for an **experienced Upholstered Furniture Design Engineer / Furniture Production Technologist** with strong practical knowledge of sofa, bed, and ottoman manufacturing, including CNC plywood frame design. Our goal is to develop a standardized collection of upholstered furniture suitable for efficient serial production. ### Project Scope We plan to develop: - 5 upholstered sofa models - 5 upholstered bed models - 5 ottoman models ### Key Responsibilities - Develop complete furniture frame structures for sofas, beds, and ottomans. - Design plywood frames using 12 mm or 15 mm plywood, depending on structural requirements. - Integrate sofa transformation mechanisms, including Puma, Tik-Tak, Dolphin, and other suitable systems. - Understand upholstery construction, foam placement, seat support systems, and furniture assembly. - Optimize frame designs for CNC cutting and efficient plywood consumption. - Develop standardized, strong, durable, and easy-to-assemble furniture structures. - Recommend practical manufacturing solutions to reduce production costs and assembly time. ### Required Deliverables 1. Complete 3D CAD models of furniture frames. 2. Detailed 2D manufacturing drawings with dimensions. 3. CNC-ready DXF files for plywood cutting. 4. Optimized plywood nesting layouts. 5. Assembly drawings and instructions. 6. Bill of Materials (BOM), including plywood, hardware, and other components. 7. Technical specifications for furniture mechanisms and mounting points. 8. Editable CAD source files. 9. Recommendations for improving production efficiency. ### Required Experience - Proven experience in upholstered furniture manufacturing and engineering. - Practical knowledge of sofa and bed frame construction. - Experience with CNC routers and plywood cutting. - Understanding of upholstery technology, foam, springs, and sofa transformation mechanisms. - Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar CAD software. - Experience designing furniture for serial manufacturing. **We are looking for a furniture production specialist, not just a 3D visualizer. Practical manufacturing experience is essential.** ### Cooperation Approach We would like to begin with **one paid test project involving a complete sofa frame with a Puma transformation mechanism**. After reviewing the drawings and successfully testing the frame in production, we plan to continue with the remaining 14 furniture models. ### When Applying, Please Provide 1. Examples of upholstered furniture projects you have previously developed. 2. Photos of actual manufactured sofa or bed frames. 3. Experience with CNC plywood frame production. 4. Experience with sofa transformation mechanisms. 5. Your price per furniture model. 6. Estimated delivery time. 7. CAD software used and available file formats. We are interested in establishing **long-term cooperation with a qualified upholstered furniture engineer** who can support the development of our furniture production line.

opportunities.title: Zoho Books Cleanup & Migration
opportunities.description: I want our charitable organization’s Zoho Books to run flawlessly inside our Zoho One environment, and I need it done as soon as possible. The work starts with a full clean-up of every ledger and sub-ledger so the closing balances line up exactly with our most recent audited statements. From there, I need custom, automated donation receipts built to meet 10BE and 10BD requirements and to fire automatically whenever a qualifying donation is posted. Expenses is the major accounting covering 95% of the transaction, want to streamline the expenses recording with minimum efforts. Because we currently sit in the US data centre, I also need the entire account—and any related services—moved to the India data centre without data loss or prolonged downtime. While you are inside the system, please activate the Fixed Assets module. Bank feeds must be linked and set to reconcile automatically, and any other repeatable process that Zoho Books can handle on its own should be automated so manual data entry is kept to a minimum. Deliverables • Reconciled books matching audited figures • Donation receipt automation for 10BE/10BD and donation receipt. • Fixed Assets module fully configured and tested • Successful migration from US DC to India DC • Bank feeds live with auto-reconciliation • Documented automation workflows and a short hand-over session • Expenses entries and invoice attachment with minimum intervention If you have deep Zoho Books experience and can move quickly, let’s get started right away.

opportunities.title: UAE National Day 3D Animation using AI
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a 3D animator to create a **45–60 second animated short** for a Grade 7 UAE National Day competition. The theme is **“The Future of the Emirates.”** The video should show how students can make their school greener while conserving water. **Working title:** «منصور وحديقة الغد» (*Mansoor and the Garden of Tomorrow*) **Story and scenes** 1. **School entrance.** Open with a recognizable 3D cartoon version of the Australian school entrance, using a reference photo I’ll provide. Show the Arabic title and the theme «إمارات المستقبل». 2. **Football.** Mansoor and his brother Hamad play football in the school courtyard. Their ball rolls into a dry, unused corner. When they go to retrieve it, Mansoor imagines turning the space into a garden. 3. **Designing the garden.** Their brother Rashid builds a miniature garden with LEGO, prints a simple outline of the plan on the blank side of a used sheet of paper, and colors it. Their sister Reem draws native UAE plants on the plan. 4. **The future garden.** The LEGO model transforms into a 3D preview of the proposed garden in the same courtyard. A close-up shows drip irrigation delivering water near the plants’ roots. End with all four siblings, the UAE flag, and the Arabic message «كل عام والإمارات بخير». **Character style and references** Mansoor is the main character. Hamad, Rashid, and Reem are supporting characters. I’ll privately share reference photos of all four children and the school entrance. Please create expressive **3D cartoon characters that closely resemble the real children**, especially in their facial features, skin tones, and hairstyles. Send one still image of all four characters together for a quick likeness check before completing the animation. No filming is needed. **Language and voice-over** The project brief is in English, but **the video, titles, and on-screen text must be in Arabic**. Mansoor will record the Arabic narration **in his own voice** and send it separately. Please animate the story using gestures and expressions so the narration can be added later as a voice-over. No lip-sync or AI-generated voice is needed. **Deadline and deliverables** - Deliver the animated version **today, 10 November 2026, by 8:00 PM UAE time (UTC+4)**. - Deliver a **landscape MP4, 1920 × 1080, without a watermark**. If the narration has not arrived by the deadline, deliver the animation on time and add Mansoor’s recording afterward as one included revision. - Keep the children’s photos and video private and use them only for this project. Please do not publish the work or use it in your portfolio. **In your bid, please include your fixed price, earliest delivery time in UAE time, and one relevant example of a 3D cartoon character created from a real photo.** Please confirm that your price includes the character preview and the final version with Mansoor’s voice-over.

opportunities.title: CNC Turning Program and CAD Drawing
opportunities.description: I have a verbal description of a small component whose job is to control the movement of a CNC machine axis. From that functional brief alone, I need you to turn the idea into both a production-ready CAD model and the matching CNC turning program. Your task begins by interpreting the performance requirements, defining the key geometry, and setting practical tolerances suitable for machining. Once the design is locked in, you will prepare a complete turning tool-path, post-processed for a modern CNC lathe, ready to load and run. Deliverables • 3D CAD model (STEP or native format) and fully dimensioned 2D drawing • Verified G-code turning program with tooling list and setup sheet • A short simulation report or screenshots proving the program runs collision-free I will review the drawing for form, fit, and function, then dry-run the code. Final approval is given when the part measures within your stated tolerances and the machine runs smoothly without alarms.

opportunities.title: Design & Development of an Enterprise-Grade Autonomous AI Business Operating System
opportunities.description: # THE AUTONOMOUS BUSINESS ENGINE ## Engineering Self-Governing Digital Operations Beyond Traditional AI Automation ### Introduction: The End of Traditional Automation For years, automation meant connecting applications, configuring triggers, and executing predefined actions. But businesses are becoming more complex. Information changes continuously, customer behaviour is unpredictable, APIs fail, and decisions require context. Traditional automation follows instructions. Generative AI produces responses. Agentic AI introduces a more powerful possibility: systems that can observe, reason, plan, execute, and verify actions within defined boundaries. The next evolution is not about creating more workflows. It is about engineering autonomous business infrastructure. An Autonomous Business Engine is an integrated architecture combining AI agents, event-driven systems, structured memory, deterministic execution, security policies, and continuous evaluation. Its objective is to transform disconnected business operations into coordinated digital intelligence. --- ### Project Scope and Priorities: This project focuses on designing and developing an enterprise-grade autonomous AI business operating system with the following priorities: 1. Enterprise-grade multi-agent AI architecture. 2. Autonomous decision-making with controlled execution. 3. Event-driven infrastructure and intelligent orchestration. 4. Persistent contextual and operational memory. 5. Advanced API integrations and distributed systems. 6. Security, governance, observability, and fault tolerance. 7. Scalable infrastructure with production-ready deployment. --- ### Phased Development Plan: **Phase 1 – Architecture & System Design** - Complete technical architecture and system blueprint. - Multi-agent AI orchestration design. - Database and business-memory architecture. - API integration specifications. - Security and governance framework. **Phase 2 – Functional Prototype** - Working multi-agent AI system. - Intelligent workflow orchestration. - Event-driven processing. - Persistent business memory. - Execution and verification mechanisms. - Initial monitoring dashboard. **Phase 3 – Production-Ready Development** - Backend APIs and frontend dashboard development. - Integration with external business applications. - Authentication and role-based access control implementation. - Error handling, retry mechanisms, and audit logging setup. - Human approval workflows and governance controls creation. **Phase 4 – Deployment & Documentation** - Complete deployment of the system in a production environment. - Testing for performance validation across use cases. - Comprehensive technical documentation delivery (API docs included). - Deployment guide creation along with final handover procedures for maintenance teams.

opportunities.title: Drone Safety Cage Electrical Design
opportunities.description: # Freelance Electrical Engineer Needed – Electrical Design and Control Cabinet for Drone Safety Cage ## Project Overview I have already completed the mechanical design of a protective cage (approximately 2.5 × 2.5 m) in Autodesk Inventor. I only need the complete electrical part of the project. I am looking for a freelancer who can design the electrical system, select and integrate all electrical components, and create the control cabinet design. **The mechanical cage does not need to be redesigned. Only the electrical components and their integration into the existing Inventor project are required.** ## 1. Existing Project - Protective cage already designed in Autodesk Inventor. - One access door. - Drone operated inside the cage. - Drone power supply: 24 V DC / 10 A. - Separate 24 V DC power supply for the safety control system. ## 2. Required Electrical Components The electrical design must include: - Safety controller (Pilz PNOZmulti 2 or suitable alternative). - Safety door switch with electrical guard locking. - Multiple safety contact mats (Sicherheitskontaktmatten) inside the cage. - Manual reset button (Reset-Taster) outside the cage. - Two redundant safety contactors for the drone power supply. - Contactor feedback monitoring. - Main switch. - Power supplies (24 V DC). - Fuses and circuit protection. - Relays, if required. - Terminal blocks and wiring accessories. ## 3. Required Work ### A. Electrical Circuit Design - Complete electrical schematic (Stromlaufplan). - Safety circuit for the door and contact mats. - Reset and control circuit. - Contactor circuit with feedback monitoring. - Component selection and compatibility checks. ### B. Control Cabinet Design (Schaltschrank) - Select and arrange all electrical components. - Position safety controller, relays, contactors, power supplies, fuses and terminals. - Create a complete control cabinet layout. - Show component mounting positions and wiring connections. ### C. Autodesk Inventor Integration - Use my existing Inventor project. - Add only the required electrical components. - Integrate the control cabinet and its internal components into the existing CAD assembly. - Provide a 3D representation of the electrical installation. - Do not redesign or modify the mechanical cage. ### D. Technical Documentation - Electrical circuit diagrams. - Control cabinet layout. - Terminal connection diagrams. - Cable and wiring list. - Bill of materials (BOM) with manufacturer names and part numbers. - Editable CAD files and PDF documentation. ## 4. opportunities.title: Custom Automated Robotic Arm – Design, 3D Printing & Delivery to Switzerland
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced Robotics / Mechanical Engineer to design, manufacture and ship a complete automated robotic arm to Switzerland. ## 1. Technical Specifications - Wall-mounted articulated robotic arm. - 1,200 mm horizontal reach. - 2 kg payload capacity at maximum reach. - 5–6 axes. - Hybrid construction: 3D-printed components and aluminium structures. - Compatible with Creality 3D printing technology. - Fully programmable automatic movements. ## 2. Main Applications The robot will perform two main operations: **A. Parcel and Envelope Handling** - Pick up envelopes and parcels from a weighing station. - Transfer them accurately onto a conveyor belt. - Handle different parcel sizes and envelope formats. **B. Automatic Shipping Label Application** - Pick up printed adhesive labels. - Position and apply labels accurately onto parcels and envelopes. - Verify correct label placement. ## 3. Vacuum Gripping System We require a vacuum-based gripping solution rather than a conventional mechanical claw. The design should include: - Adjustable vacuum suction cups for parcels and envelopes. - A dedicated precision vacuum head for small adhesive labels. - Vacuum pressure sensors to confirm successful pickup. - Automatic vacuum release. - Replaceable suction cups. - A suitable compliant application surface to prevent label wrinkles. - Modular tooling at the robot wrist. ## 4. Machine Vision The system must include cameras and vision software capable of: - Detecting the presence and position of parcels and envelopes. - Identifying dimensions and orientation. - Determining suitable label application positions. - Guiding the robotic arm. - Verifying successful label application. Possible technologies: Raspberry Pi, OpenCV or industrial machine vision systems. ## 5. Existing Rollo Wireless Printer – Must Be Preserved We already operate a Rollo Wireless thermal label printer connected to our existing shipping software. The existing sequential printing system must remain completely unchanged. - No replacement or reprogramming of the printer. - No modification of the existing printing workflow. - Label format: 1 × 2 inches (25.4 × 50.8 mm). - Automatic detection and retrieval of each printed label. - Synchronization between the printed label and the corresponding parcel. - Automatic verification before proceeding to the next label. The freelancer must design the mechanical and electronic interface required to retrieve and apply the labels. ## 6. Control System Please propose and compare two alternatives: **Option A:** Arduino Mega 2560. **Option B:** Arduino GIGA R1 WiFi. Both solutions should integrate with a dedicated vision system, such as Raspberry Pi / OpenCV, and suitable motor drivers, encoders and safety devices. Automatic programmable pick-and-place sequences are required. ## 7. Complete Manufacturing and Delivery We expect the freelancer to handle the entire project, including: - Mechanical and electronic engineering. - Complete CAD design. - STL, STEP and native CAD files. - 3D printing of all required components. - Supply of aluminium and other mechanical components. - Motors, gearboxes, drivers, sensors and electronics. - Vacuum gripper and label application mechanism. - Complete Bill of Materials (BOM). - Assembly instructions and wiring diagrams. - Arduino and vision software source code. - Testing and demonstration videos. - Quality inspection and secure packaging. - International shipping of the manufactured components to Switzerland. ## 8. Freelancer Requirements Please provide: - Previous robotic arm projects. - Experience in mechanical engineering and robotics. - Examples of 3D-printed robotic components. - Available printing materials and manufacturing capabilities. - Experience with machine vision and vacuum gripping systems. - Estimated production time and shipping costs. ## 9. Results Please quote engineering, manufacturing, components and international shipping separately. We are looking for a complete, functional and documented solution, not simply a 3D model. Please explain your proposed architecture and identify any technical limitations before submitting your final quotation. Please provide examples of past similar work.

opportunities.title: Black Friday Lead Generation Ads
opportunities.description: Paid Ads Specialist for Black Friday Campaign – Oslo Markise (Lead Generation) Description: We are looking for a sharp paid ads specialist to build and manage our upcoming Black Friday campaign for Oslo Markise. Our core Black Friday offer is 55% off all products (excluding motors and automation). The primary goal is to generate qualified leads (quote requests) during the Black Friday push. What we need help with: Platform Choice & Strategy: Sun shading is a high-ticket item. We need your call on how to split the budget between Google Search and Meta Ads to get actual quote requests, not just clicks. Landing Page Setup: Help us structure or build a high-converting landing page specifically tailored to this offer. Campaign Setup & Norwegian Ad Copy: Create ad sets, write high-converting ad copy in fluent Norwegian based on the 55% offer, set up audience/keyword targeting, and make sure conversion tracking is working (Pixel, GTM, CAPI). Daily Management: Monitor bids, optimize budgets, and tune targeting throughout the campaign (~1 month). Reporting: Keep track of leads generated, cost per lead (CPL), and conversion rates. What we expect: Solid experience running lead gen campaigns for high-ticket products on Google and Meta. Ability to deliver native-quality Norwegian ad copy and messaging. Hands-on knowledge of landing page optimization and technical tracking setups. Good written English for communication with us. Long-Term Opportunity: This is initially a 1-month contract for the Black Friday run. If the campaign delivers strong results and good quality leads, we want to continue with a long-term partnership for our ongoing marketing.

opportunities.title: Automated Daily Ad View Bot
opportunities.description: I need a hands-off solution that racks up at least 1,000 completed video-ad views every day on a revenue-sharing site of my choice. The platform, language, and tooling are completely up to you—you might prefer Python with Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer, or another headless-browser approach—so long as the views register as genuine on the site’s analytics and keep my account in good standing. The script must: • Run continuously without manual clicks, automatically playing each ad to the point where a view is credited. • Rotate user agents, IPs, or any other identifiers required to avoid detection. • Log every view in an easy-to-verify way (simple CSV, dashboard readout, or timestamped screenshots are all fine). • Start and stop cleanly on a typical VPS or desktop environment and recover gracefully after a reboot. Deliverables • Source code with clear setup instructions. • A short video or live screen-share demo proving 1,000 successful ad completions in a 24-hour window. • Daily log or report template I can use to track ongoing performance. If additional services such as proxies, captchas, or cloud resources are needed, let me know up front so I can factor them in. Once everything is working and the first 1,000-view day is confirmed, I’ll release full payment and we can discuss scaling beyond that if desired.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Business Intelligence Platform
opportunities.description: - Data validation, error handling, security and cost optimisation. Experience in B2B intelligence platforms, financial technology, corporate finance, investment research, lead generation or sales automation would be advantageous. What We Are Looking For: We are not simply looking for someone who can connect existing AI tools together. We need an experienced engineer who can assess our requirements, recommend the right technology stack, design a scalable architecture and implement reliable AI-powered workflows. You should have experience deploying production applications, not just developing demonstrations or proof-of-concept chatbots. We are open to different technologies and approaches, including custom development, existing AI frameworks and hybrid solutions. The selected engineer should be able to explain the advantages, limitations, costs and scalability of their proposed architecture. Project Phases Phase 1 – Technical Prototype (2–4 weeks) Build a working demonstration of automated company research, financing-signal identification, data verification and CRM integration using real UAE business data. Deliver a proposed system architecture, development roadmap and estimated ongoing operating costs. Phase 2 – Operational MVP (approximately 8–12 weeks, subject to successful prototype) Develop the prototype into a reliable, cloud-hosted application capable of conducting ongoing research, qualifying opportunities, maintaining CRM records and supporting approved outreach and basic lender matching. Phase 3 – Full Platform Development Expand the system across all six business functions, introduce advanced matching, relationship intelligence, additional workflows and improved automation. The longer-term development scope and budget will be agreed after validating the initial stages. Deliverables & Working Arrangements We expect: - A clear technical architecture and implementation plan. - Working, demonstrable software. - Documented source code and database structure. - Secure, appropriately authorised integrations. - Testing, error handling and monitoring. - Transparent reporting on development progress. - Clearly defined milestones and acceptance criteria. - Deployment documentation and handover. Development should take place in company-controlled repositories and infrastructure. Source-code ownership, intellectual property rights and access arrangements will be clearly defined contractually. We are comfortable working remotely and prefer regular progress updates with working demonstrations rather than lengthy status reports. Application Requirements Please provide: 1. Examples of AI-powered research, commercial intelligence, data engineering or business automation platforms you have personally developed and deployed. 2. Your recommended high-level technical approach and technology stack for this project. 3. Your experience with HubSpot, AI agents, external data APIs and cloud-based automation. 4. One major technical challenge you anticipate with this project and how you would address it. 5. What you could realistically deliver within a 2–4-week paid prototype. 6. Your estimated timeline, hourly rate and indicative budget for the prototype and subsequent MVP. Please clarify whether you would personally lead development or work with additional engineers. We value practical experience, clear communication and independently considered technical recommendations. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate similar systems they have built and explain the architecture behind them. A detailed project requirements document will be made available to shortlisted candidates. We are looking for a reliable, technically strong engineer who can help us develop this platform from initial prototype through to a scalable, production-ready system.

opportunities.title: Optimize Dubai Printing Google Ads
opportunities.description: **Project Title: Google Ads Expert Needed for Existing Printing & Advertising Business in Dubai, UAE** We are looking for a highly experienced Google Ads Specialist to manage, audit, optimize, and improve Google Ads campaigns for our established printing and advertising company. We have been running Google Ads for approximately 4–5 years and already have historical campaign data. **Scope of Work:** 1. Conduct a complete audit of our existing Google Ads account, including campaign performance over previous years. 2. Review existing campaigns and identify what should be continued, improved, paused, or rebuilt. 3. Create or restructure 4–5 high-performing Google Search campaigns. 4. Perform detailed keyword research targeting customers searching for printing and advertising services in Dubai and the UAE. 5. Identify high-converting keywords and continuously update negative keyword lists. 6. Optimize ad headlines, descriptions, bidding strategies, search terms, targeting, and advertising schedules. 7. Set up and verify accurate conversion tracking for phone calls, WhatsApp inquiries, website forms, and other qualified leads. 8. Review landing pages and recommend improvements to increase conversion rates. 9. Monitor campaigns regularly, reduce wasted advertising spend, and improve cost per qualified lead. 10. Provide weekly performance reports with leads, conversions, spending, keyword performance, and optimization actions. **Our Main Services:** - Business Cards & Digital Printing - Flyers, Brochures & Catalogues - Paper Bags, Boxes & Packaging Printing - Roll-Up Banners & Exhibition Printing - Signboards & Outdoor Advertising - Offset Printing & Urgent Printing Services **Our Goal:** We want to generate more genuine customer inquiries, improve lead quality, increase conversions, and achieve better results from our existing advertising budget. We are looking for an expert who can provide ongoing management, not just one-time campaign setup. **Requirements:** - Proven Google Ads experience - Experience with UAE/Dubai local lead-generation campaigns - Strong knowledge of Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking - Ability to analyze historical performance data - Transparent reporting and regular campaign optimization Please share your previous results, proposed strategy, monthly management fee, and how you would improve our existing campaigns.

Here is what I expect: • A clean, reproducible installation of Claude Code with all supporting packages, drivers, and browser-automation libraries set up so everything runs from a single launch script. • At least two sample workflows that log in, pull data from a local file (Excel, PDF, or another online tool), populate the target portal accurately, and confirm submission. • Clear, step-by-step notes or a short screen-recording showing me how to tweak field mappings and add new sites on my own. Success means I can press “Run,” watch an AI agent complete a typical form or document retrieval task end-to-end, and see a concise log showing what it did. If that sounds straightforward to you, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Build PULSE Business Operating System
opportunities.description: PULSE. | A Business Operating System Running a business often means switching between WhatsApp conversations, spreadsheets, calendars, payment records, and multiple applications just to understand what is happening. PULSE brings everything together into one beautifully designed, intelligent workspace. The idea is simple: a business owner should be able to open one screen and understand their entire business within seconds. What it does - Live business overview: Revenue, appointments, pending work, customers, and daily performance in one place. - Customer management: Complete customer histories, conversations, preferences, and previous transactions. - Smart scheduling: Appointments, employee availability, task assignments, and automatic reminders. - Financial intelligence: Track payments, expenses, outstanding invoices, profitability, and business trends. - Automated workflows: Generate invoices, send updates, assign work, and manage recurring operations. - AI business assistant: Ask natural questions such as "Which services earned the most last month?" and receive answers based on actual business data. - Customizable interface: Each business can choose which metrics, tools, and information matter most to them. Design philosophy A powerful application does not need to look complicated. PULSE would use a minimal, distraction-free interface with subtle animations, intuitive navigation, and thoughtful details that make even complex operations feel effortless. Technology: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, real-time updates, and optional OpenAI integration. The bigger idea PULSE would be designed as a modular platform. A garage, salon, consulting firm, repair company, or growing service business could each use a version tailored to its actual workflow. One foundation. Different businesses. No unnecessary complexity. Concept project, proposed for development.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Banquet Hall Layout
opportunities.description: I’m preparing to build out a new banquet hall and need a precise AutoCAD drawing that covers the event hall, dedicated stage, and full seating area. I’ll provide the building shell and column grid; you’ll turn that into a clear, build-ready plan that shows stage dimensions, table-and-chair positioning, aisles, and exit routes while making the best use of the available floor space. Please work directly in AutoCAD (any recent version is fine), organise layers logically, and dimension everything in metric units so my contractor can drop the file straight into their workflow. A quick first pass within three days would be ideal, followed by up to two rounds of tweaks after I review. Acceptance criteria • DWG and PDF of the complete event hall, stage, and seating layout • All critical dimensions and clear circulation paths shown • Layers, blocks, and text styles tidy and fully editable

opportunities.title: Logo Conversion to DWG & HD
opportunities.description: I have my logo in a clear PNG/JPG and need it rebuilt as a true vector so that every curve and line is identical to the original. The primary file I’m after is a clean DWG that I can drop straight into CAD and laser-cut software, but I also want high-resolution exports for merchandise. The artwork must be an exact match—no tweaks or simplifications—because it will appear on T-shirts, hats, mugs, stickers, packaging, large signs, and engraved items. Colours, proportions, and any fine details have to stay untouched so everything looks consistent across fabric, print, and cutting applications. Deliverables • DWG file compatible with AutoCAD and similar tools • Master vector in AI or SVG for printers • Print-ready PDF and 300 dpi PNG on transparent background • Confirmation that the drawing is 100 % vector with no embedded bitmaps I’ll send the reference image as soon as we start; once I verify the match, the project is complete.

opportunities.title: Export Stone Social Lead Generation
opportunities.description: Our export-focused stone company is ready to turn LinkedIn, Instagram, and WhatsApp into consistent pipelines of qualified international buyer enquiries. The immediate objective is simple: more export buyer leads, and quickly. To achieve this, the campaign must combine LinkedIn prospecting and outreach, Instagram content that showcases our slabs, tiles, and finished products, plus WhatsApp follow-ups that convert interest into confirmed RFQs. I will supply brand guidelines, existing catalogues, and access to our current social profiles. You bring the strategy, creatives, and execution plan that ties all three channels together and starts producing fresh enquiries within the first weeks. Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining: • Your approach for targeting and connecting with purchasing managers, importers, and distributors on LinkedIn. • The content calendar and ad formats you will use on Instagram to highlight product varieties, finishes, and certifications. • Message flows and automation (where permitted) for WhatsApp that nurture leads without spamming. • Key metrics you will track and how quickly we can expect the first tangible uptick in qualified enquiries. The timeline is ASAP; the sooner the first campaigns go live, the better.

opportunities.title: AI Multilingual LMS Content Creation
opportunities.description: I’m building a social-impact LMS and I want its very first modules produced automatically with AI in English, Hindi and Telugu and all local languages of India. The goal is to transform the topics I send you into concise video, audio lessons that are paired with clean, on-brand visual slides. Here’s the workflow I have in mind: I share a batch of lesson topics and key points; you structure each topic into a clear learning script, run it through your preferred AI voice generator for a natural-sounding narration, and assemble matching slide visuals that reinforce the spoken content. Each lesson should feel uniform across the three languages, with consistent pace, slide design and audio quality. Deliverables per topic • Script (one master English version plus translated Hindi and Telugu versions) • AI-generated audio files in all three languages (MP3 or WAV) • Slide deck synced to the audio (PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar) • Source files and a brief note on the AI tools and settings used so the process can be repeated internally I value clear pronunciation, culturally appropriate phrasing and easy-to-read slides far more than flashy animation. If you already work with tools such as ElevenLabs, Descript, Murf, Canva or PowerPoint automation, that’s perfect—just let me know your stack. Once the first topic is approved we’ll scale to additional lessons, so please factor repeatability into your approach.

opportunities.title: Portal de Reservas para Casa Vacacional
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar un sitio web propio para mi casa de renta vacacional que permita a cualquier huésped elegir fechas disponibles, pagar el total de la estancia en el momento y recibir la confirmación automática. Todo debe funcionar con pagos en línea seguros —pienso en Stripe o PayPal, aunque estoy abierto a sugerencias— y emitir los correos de confirmación y recibos correspondientes. Necesito que el calendario se sincronice a dos vías con mi anuncio de Airbnb, no solo para mostrar disponibilidad: también debe importar y exportar precios, reservas ya hechas y los mensajes de los huéspedes para evitar doble trabajo. Si hay variaciones de tarifa, temporadas o descuentos, quiero poder actualizarlos yo mismo desde un panel claro y que se reflejen tanto en mi web como en Airbnb. Desde el mismo panel de administración debo: • revisar y gestionar reservas, pagos y calendario en tiempo real • modificar precios, temporadas y cupones sin depender de un desarrollador • crear promociones rápidamente y publicarlas en redes sociales, incluyendo TikTok, Facebook e Instagram, con un par de clics El sitio debe cargarse rápido, ser responsive y quedar bien indexado por Google para captar tráfico orgánico. Agradeceré que la estructura y los textos clave vengan optimizados para SEO básico y que me indiques cómo añadir más contenido después. Entrego branding, fotos y detalles de la propiedad; tú te encargas de diseño, desarrollo, pasarela de pago, conexión con Airbnb y la herramienta de publicación social. Prefiero WordPress + WooCommerce + channel manager compatible, pero escucharé otras stacks si justificas las ventajas. Al finalizar espero: 1.Gestion multiple para enviar publicidad a redes y google 2. Pasarela de pago operativa y reserva 100 % en línea funcionando 3. Sincronización completa con Airbnb verificada 4. Tutorial breve (video o PDF) para que pueda gestionar todo sin asistencia Si tienes experiencia demostrable en sitios de booking vacacional y saber conectar con Airbnb, envíame ejemplos y tu plan de trabajo.

opportunities.title: Importación AliExpress-Shopify Masiva
opportunities.description: Necesito optimizar mi tienda Shopify para añadir rápidamente una gran cantidad de artículos de AliExpress que yo misma iré seleccionando. Busco una solución — sea configuración de una app existente (DSers, AliExpress Dropshipping, Zendrop, etc.) o un desarrollo a medida — que me permita: • Importar solo los productos que elija, pero de forma masiva, y que al traerlos se copie absolutamente toda la información disponible: imágenes, títulos, descripciones, variantes, modelos, precios, stock y opciones de envío. • Una vez que entren pedidos en Shopify, estos deben crearse de forma automática en AliExpress con todos los datos del cliente listos para pagar, sin que yo tenga que intervenir manualmente. Entrego acceso a la tienda y a la cuenta de AliExpress. El trabajo se considera completo cuando pueda: 1. Recibir un pedido de prueba en Shopify y confirmarlo levantado automáticamente en AliExpress listo para el pago. Incluye breve guía en video o PDF mostrando cómo repetir el proceso y resolver posibles errores.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp-Shopify Automation Setup
opportunities.description: Quiero que todo el flujo de atención al cliente por WhatsApp quede completamente automatizado y conectado con mi tienda de Shopify. El bot debe: • Responder de inmediato las preguntas frecuentes sobre productos, variantes y existencias tomando la información actual de mi catálogo en Shopify. • Enviar cotizaciones con los precios fijos que ya manejo en la tienda, darles seguimiento y reactivar al cliente si no responde. • Cuando el cliente confirme la compra, generar el pedido directamente en Shopify y devolver por WhatsApp el enlace de pago correspondiente. Me sirve cualquier enfoque que combine la API de WhatsApp Business con Shopify (por ejemplo, Twilio, Meta Cloud API, o un desarrollo propio en Node.js/Python) siempre que sea estable y fácil de mantener. Entrego acceso a mi cuenta de WhatsApp Business y a la API de Shopify; espero de tu parte el flujo configurado, documentación breve sobre cómo modificar mensajes o reglas, y una prueba en vivo que demuestre: 1. Consulta de stock respondida en tiempo real. 2. Cotización emitida con precio exacto desde Shopify. 3. Pedido creado y enlace de pago enviado automáticamente. Si ya has hecho algo similar, mencióname qué stack usaste y cuánto tardarías en implementarlo.

opportunities.title: Difusión Shopify en Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Necesito automatizar y ejecutar la publicación masiva de todo mi catálogo de Shopify — organizado por categorías — en TikTok, Instagram y Facebook. El objetivo es que cada producto se muestre en los tres formatos que más convierten para mi tienda: • Imágenes publicitarias con su precio y la oferta vigente. • Videos cortos que muestren el producto en uso, listos para TikTok/Reels. • Publicaciones con fotos y descripciones completas extraídas del catálogo. Entrego acceso a Shopify y a los perfiles sociales; tú te encargas de seleccionar la mejor herramienta o flujo (puede ser nativo de Shopify, apps de programación o tu propio sistema) para que el proceso quede lo más automatizado posible. Espero artes finales optimizados en tamaño y proporción para cada red, copys persuasivos en español e inglés si fuera necesario y programación del contenido en un calendario inicial de prueba. Acepto propuestas que incluyan: 1. Plan de trabajo con hitos claros para cada red. 2. Ejemplos de piezas visuales antes de publicarlas. 3. Métricas mínimas que medirás para confirmar que el contenido se publica correctamente (impresiones, clicks, etc.). Cuando terminemos la fase de publicación, el objetivo es que el flujo quede documentado para yo poder continuar programando contenido futuro por mi cuenta o repetir la estrategia en nuevas colecciones.

Cualquier duda que tengas sobre la empresa o el enfoque, la resolvemos antes de empezar para que puedas trabajar con total claridad.

opportunities.title: Social Media Manager, UGC Content Creator & Video Editor – Family Travel Brand
opportunities.description: Project Type: Long-term opportunity (starting with a paid trial) Category: Social Media Marketing | Video Editing | UGC Content Creation | Content Strategy Project Overview We are an Australian family of three launching a new travel brand across Instagram and TikTok. We have an extensive collection of travel photos, videos and drone footage from our adventures around the world, which we have recently finished organizing. We are looking for a creative, experienced freelancer who can help us turn our travel content into a successful, income-generating social media business. Our main goal is to monetize our content through UGC brand deals, paid collaborations, sponsored travel and affiliate marketing, while growing an engaged social media audience. We are not simply looking for someone to edit videos. We want someone who understands how to create engaging content, build a recognizable brand and develop opportunities for monetization. Our Content Focus Our brand will feature: - Family travel and adventure: Beautiful destinations, luxury resorts, affordable travel, unique experiences and drone footage. - Neurodivergent family travel: Sharing the challenges, rewards, funny moments and practical strategies involved in travelling the world as a neurodivergent family. - UGC content: Professional, authentic promotional videos designed to attract partnerships with hotels, resorts, tourism operators and travel brands. - Affiliate marketing: Featuring useful travel products, sensory-friendly products and other items relevant to neurodivergent families. Skills We're Looking For Ideally, our freelancer will have experience in: - Professional video and photo editing, including cinematic travel Reels. - Instagram and TikTok content creation and growth strategies. - UGC video creation and content suitable for brand advertising. - Social media marketing, storytelling, hooks, captions and trending content. - Brand partnerships, UGC portfolios and monetization strategies. - Affiliate marketing and integrating products naturally into content. - AI-assisted editing tools and efficient content production workflows. Experience working with travel, family or lifestyle brands would be highly regarded. Initial Trial Project We would like to begin with three professionally edited Reels to assess creativity, editing quality and understanding of our brand. 1. Cinematic Travel Reel: Showcasing beautiful destinations, resorts, adventures and drone footage. 2. Family Introduction Reel: Introducing our family and our neurodivergent travel experiences in a fun, relatable and engaging way. 3. UGC-Style Promotional Reel: Featuring a specific hotel, resort or travel experience, demonstrating the type of professional content we could create for paying brands. We will provide the original footage, photographs, drone videos and branding materials. We welcome creative suggestions regarding music, voiceovers, storytelling and presentation. Any music used for commercial UGC must have appropriate licensing. Long-Term Opportunity If the trial is successful, we hope to establish an ongoing working relationship. Our longer-term goals include: - Publishing approximately 5–7 high-quality Reels per week. - Growing our Instagram and TikTok accounts. - Building a professional UGC portfolio and media kit. - Developing strategies to attract paid UGC contracts and brand collaborations. - Exploring affiliate marketing opportunities. - Eventually expanding into social media management and brand outreach. We are particularly interested in someone who can take initiative, suggest creative ideas and help guide our strategy as the business develops. When Applying Please tell us: 1. What experience do you have with travel content, UGC creation and social media marketing? 2. Have you helped other creators or businesses secure paid UGC opportunities or monetize their content? 3. Can you share examples of Reels you've edited and UGC-style advertisements you've created? 4. Are you comfortable helping with content strategy and audience growth, rather than editing alone? 5. What would you charge for an initial three-Reel trial and an ongoing monthly arrangement? We're looking for a reliable, creative partner who is genuinely interested in helping us build a successful long-term travel content business. We look forward to hearing from you!

opportunities.title: Pruebas Integrales de Ciberseguridad
opportunities.description: Quiero poner a prueba tanto la página web pública como nuestro CRM interno. Necesito que se ejecute una batería completa de pruebas de seguridad sobre todas sus funciones: lógica de negocio, control de acceso, inyección de código, gestión de sesiones, cifrado de datos y cualquier otra superficie de ataque relevante. Para las pruebas facilitaré acceso de usuario normal a ambos entornos. Con esas credenciales deberás identificar cualquier vulnerabilidad que un atacante pudiera aprovechar sin privilegios elevados. Entregables esperados: • Informe técnico con cada hallazgo, gravedad, riesgo real y demostración paso a paso. • Recomendaciones claras de mitigación o corrección. • Sesión online con nuestro equipo de soporte para revisar los fallos y guiarlos en la implementación de las soluciones. Valoro experiencia en OWASP, pruebas de penetración web, análisis de aplicaciones CRM y generación de informes ejecutivos y técnicos.
